title: The Exodus (foundational narrative)
summary: Position 1: the exodus from Egypt is the founding narrative of Israelite religion and is treated by the tradition as historical. Position 2: archaeology and Egyptology find no direct corroboration, and most scholars treat the narrative's historicity as unresolved. The record dates the narrative's traditional setting, not a verified event.
